description: Original pixels: one x-displacement / s-position frame with upward and rightward axis arrows, capital O, no ticks or numeric scale. Scan skew and the short axis scan gap are rectified additions, not new source data.

Original earlier t solid curve: 12 observed defining anchors, three crests, two troughs and finite shared interval. Rises through O. Source anchors are inventoried before interpolation; sampled sine coordinates are uncalibrated regularization.

Original later t + Delta t solid curve: 12 observed defining anchors, three crests, two troughs and finite shared interval. Rises from below O at s=0 and is the same wave translated right. Source anchors are inventoried before interpolation; sampled sine coordinates are uncalibrated regularization.

Five original inter-curve crossings, with positive/negative/positive/negative/positive displacement signs, in the same frame. Equality and both branches are explicit native points, not unchecked opaque paths.

Original lambda span with two outward arrowheads and two vertical guides joins the first two earlier crests. The regularized nearest same-phase crest separation is one schematic wavelength; no number is drawn.

Original Delta s = v middle-dot Delta t annotation with two outward arrowheads and vertical guides joins the third earlier and later crests. Shift is rightward; symbolic only. Actual translation assertions are in the spec and additional mathematical gate.
Original rightward propagation arrow under v and separate small rightward vector-accent arrow above v. Preserve both, with no new numeric velocity.
Original t leader points up/right onto the earlier descending branch; t + Delta t leader points up/left onto the later ascending branch. Both literal labels remain distinct and correctly attached.
